title: Malicious code in @silent404/baileys (npm)
description: The @silent404/baileys npm package declares a dependency on libsignal via a git URL without pinning to a specific commit, tag, or ref. This means that during installation, the package fetches and executes code from the default branch of an external repository without integrity verification. Control over that external repository or its default branch allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on any machine installing the package. This package is a third-party republish of the Baileys library and thus inherits this risk from the unpinned dependency.
